original=original.replace("output=Path('/private/tmp/fq-v4-capacity-delivered-workflows-20261123.json')","output=Path(os.environ['FQ_CAPACITY_OUTPUT'])")
worker=Path('/private/tmp/fq-v4-capacity-fresh-worker-20261123.py');worker.write_text(original)
report={'scope':'Inspected development inputs; unchanged SDKBench evaluator; macOS RSS observed, no memory enforcement or comparative performance claim','wall_budget_seconds_per_worker':20,'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'worker_source':original,'rows':[],'complete':False}

for fixture in sorted(Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-external-input-preparation-20261123/prepared/bundle/fixtures').glob('*.json')):
 target=Path('/private/tmp/fq-v4-fresh-'+fixture.stem+'-20261123.json')
 env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH='.:/private/tmp/sdkbench-external-programs-20261123/src',FQ_CAPACITY_FIXTURE=str(fixture),FQ_CAPACITY_OUTPUT=str(target))
 started=time.monotonic()
 code="import runpy,resource,json;runpy.run_path("+repr(str(worker))+");print(json.dumps({'peak_rss_bytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}))"
 p=subprocess.Popen(['/Users/baai/Documents/liuwei/sdkbench/.venv/bin/python','-c',code],cwd=root,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
 row={'instance':fixture.stem}
 try:

 row['process_wall_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started

"""Check the approved capacity candidate through unchanged target workflows."""
import hashlib,json,os,platform,subprocess,time,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import torch
from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter,workflow_configuration
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing

torch.set_num_threads(1)
root=Path.cwd()
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,timeout=15).strip()
assert head=='ceccc29816014a43d3ee1fcbf4445433c3a6846c'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True,timeout=15)
harness=Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-external-programs-20261123')
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=harness,text=True,timeout=15).strip()=='5ba03de33f8a9193f86b26d2cb3fa841ede7c98a'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=harness,text=True,timeout=15)
bundle=Bundle(harness/'docs/implementation')
result={'scope':'Approved capacity candidate delivered-workflow regression check on six inspected inputs, not comparative timing or qualified publication evidence','revision':head,'v4_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'flagquantum/core/_compilation_evidence_v4.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'environment':{'python':platform.python_version(),'platform':platform.system(),'numerical_threads_requested':1,'memory_cgroup_enforced':False},'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'rows':[],'complete':False}
output=Path(os.environ['FQ_CAPACITY_OUTPUT'])
for path in [Path(os.environ['FQ_CAPACITY_FIXTURE'])]:
 source=json.loads(path.read_text())
 config=workflow_configuration('flagquantum-target-artifact')
 adapter=load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options':{'sdk':config['sdk'],'workflow':'flagquantum-target-artifact','compiler_options':config}}))
 row={'instance':path.stem,'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 started=time.monotonic()
 try:
  payload=adapter.execute('route',source,0)
  acceptance=bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if source['n_qubits']==8 else 'ROUTE-LINE-06']
  metrics=routing(payload,source,None,acceptance,0)
  row.update(status='accepted',metrics=metrics,payload=payload,audit=adapter.audit,compiler_evidence=adapter.native.compiler_evidence)
 except Exception as exc:
  row.update(status='error',exception=type(exc).__name__,message=str(exc),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
 row['diagnostic_wall_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
 result['rows'].append(row);output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k in ('instance','status','message','metrics','diagnostic_wall_seconds')}),flush=True)
result['complete']=True
output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
